AC-01.title: Graphify Engine AST Extraction
AC-01.evidence: Tree-sitter extraction across Python, TypeScript, and Go produces AST nodes and call/import edges with confidence EXTRACTED (1.0) in < 3s without LLM dependencies.

AC-02.title: Incremental SHA256 Caching
AC-02.evidence: Workspace re-run achieves 100% cache hits. Stripping YAML frontmatter prevents AST invalidation when metadata alone changes.

AC-03.title: Multimodal Document Extraction
AC-03.evidence: DOCX, XLSX, Markdown, and PDF ingestion produces document nodes (file_type='document'), section hierarchies, tables, and rationale_for/cites edges.

AC-04.title: Leiden Community Partitioning
AC-04.evidence: NetworkX Leiden community detection clusters entities deterministically, splits oversized clusters (>25% total nodes), and isolates centrality god nodes.

AC-05.title: MCP Document Upload Tool
AC-05.evidence: Invoking projectbrain_upload_document in PB_MODE='remote' processes documents locally and streams JSON payloads to POST /sources/push-processed on the server.

AC-06.title: 63-Byte PostgreSQL Schema Isolation
AC-06.evidence: Sanitization formula pb_br_{proj[:16]}_{branch[:28]}_{hash8} guarantees collision-resistant PostgreSQL schema names <= 63 bytes conforming to ^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$.

AC-07.title: SQL Injection Resistance
AC-07.evidence: Branch names containing quotes and SQL statements (e.g. `feature'; DROP TABLE users;--`) are sanitized and interpolated exclusively through psycopg2.sql.Identifier.

AC-08.title: O(Delta) Branch-to-Root Diff
AC-08.evidence: Branch diffing inspects solely overlay tables (node_upserts, node_tombstones, edge_upserts, edge_tombstones), executing in < 25ms without table scans of canonical root.

AC-09.title: Branch-to-Branch Partial Diff
AC-09.evidence: Diffing branch A against branch B evaluates O(Delta_A union Delta_B) mutations, isolating added, modified, and deleted entities between overlays.

AC-10.title: Atomic Branch Promotion
AC-10.evidence: promote_branch_to_root executes within a single transaction: applies tombstones, upserts root records, drops branch schema CASCADE, and cleans registry.

AC-11.title: SQLite Overlay Fallback
AC-11.evidence: SqliteOverlayGraphStore emulates PostgreSQL schema overlay views via CTEs and prefixed tables, achieving 100% test determinism offline.

AC-12.title: Local Partial Graphify Run
AC-12.evidence: projectbrain_sync_graphify with scoped_paths and local_only=True generates .projectbrain/local_graph/partial_graph.json containing only localized entities.

AC-13.title: 3-Tier Hybrid KB Resolution
AC-13.evidence: projectbrain_hybrid_query resolves entities with strict precedence: local working overlay > server branch schema > canonical root schema.

AC-14.title: Tombstone Suppression
AC-14.evidence: Entities marked in node_tombstones or edge_tombstones are completely suppressed from resolved views and hybrid traversals even if present in canonical root.

AC-15.title: Web Dashboard Vis.js Compatibility
AC-15.evidence: Legacy endpoint /codegraph/data translates Graphify NetworkX structures into {nodes, edges} payloads with community colors and kind groups for Vis.js.

AC-KB-01.title: Multi-Format Unified Document Ingestion & Chunking
AC-KB-01.evidence: DocumentPipeline and CodeDocLinker chunk Markdown, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, PDF, and CSV into 603 semantic chunks preserving hierarchical heading breadcrumbs and code fences.

AC-KB-02.title: Grounded AST Community Wiki Generation
AC-KB-02.evidence: ProjectDocSynthesizer generates 73 grounded wiki pages including index.md, architecture_overview.md, api_and_mcp_reference.md, database_and_schemas.md, and 69 Leiden community breakdowns.

AC-KB-03.title: Topological Graph Structural & Health Analysis
AC-KB-03.evidence: GRAPH_REPORT.md provides deterministic architectural health analysis across 2,351 nodes and 24,593 edges, isolating God nodes, degree distributions, and bridge components.

AC-KB-04.title: Multi-Sheet Excel Traceability Matrix Export
AC-KB-04.evidence: ProjectBrain_Traceability_Matrix.xlsx contains 4 richly populated sheets: Code_To_Doc_Links (21,417 rows), Doc_Chunks_Inventory (604 rows), API_And_MCP_Endpoints (120 rows), and Coverage_And_Gaps (10 rows).

AC-KB-05.title: Architectural Word Specification Generation
AC-KB-05.evidence: ProjectBrain_Architecture_Spec.docx (40.1 KB) exports formatted executive summaries, repository metric tables, subsystem architectures, and API catalog.

AC-KB-06.title: Executive PowerPoint Architecture Presentation
AC-KB-06.evidence: ProjectBrain_Architecture_Deck.pptx (37.2 KB) produces a 7-slide executive deck covering system topology, Leiden modularity, God nodes, API/MCP tools, cognitive memory, and verification metrics.

AC-KB-07.title: Bidirectional Code-to-Doc-to-Test Cross-Linkage
AC-KB-07.evidence: CodeDocLinker establishes 21,441 bidirectional cross-domain edges across documents_symbol, documented_in, specifies_endpoint, verifies_symbol, and conceptually_related_to relations.

AC-KB-08.title: Cross-Domain Code-Doc Drift Detection
AC-KB-08.evidence: CodeDocDrift engine detects source files modified more recently than linked docs, removed symbols lingering in documentation, and stale signature references.

AC-KB-09.title: Unified Traceability & Cross-Domain Query (kb-trace)
AC-KB-09.evidence: UnifiedKBBuilder.trace_code_and_docs and CLI kb-trace retrieve a unified composite view linking code AST nodes, doc chunks, test suites, callers, callees, and drift alerts for any symbol, route, or doc heading.

AC-KB-10.title: Live End-to-End Knowledge Base Coverage & Verification
AC-KB-10.evidence: Full build-kb execution against live Project-Brain repository achieves 85.71% code-to-doc coverage, 100.0% REST API coverage, 100.0% FastMCP tool coverage, 433 HSG memories, 5,483 waypoints, and 0 test failures.
